headline: Replacer struct impacts multiple modules
what_breaks: crates/printer/src/hyperlink/mod.rs — uses Replacer for hyperlink processing
crates/printer/src/stats.rs — relies on Replacer for statistical replacements
crates/printer/src/json.rs — integrates Replacer for JSON formatting
why: The Replacer struct is central to handling string replacements across various modules. Any changes to its methods or structure could disrupt functionality in dependent files.
checklist: Review changes to Replacer methods, especially replace_all
Check for impacts on Searcher and Matcher interfaces used in Replacer
Ensure compatibility with MAX_LOOK_AHEAD constant in related modules
